51.steps:
1. In the Network->Interfaces page, add one Sub interface with WAN zone and with static ip address, like X1:V155, and add another sub interface with LAN zone and with static ip address, like X0:V100.
  2. Set the interface X1:V155 as default WAN.
  3. Get the CFS liscense.
  4. In the Security Services ->Content Filter page, make sure that the Content Filter Server is ready and select "Via User and Zones Screens" from the CFS Policy Assignment drop-down list, and select "SonicWALL CFS" from Content Filter Type drop-down list.
  5. Click the Confige button to enter into SonicWALL Filter Properties page , then switch to Plicy tab and add a policy named custom , and select the categories "shopping" as forbidden categories.
  6. Navigate to Network->Zones page, check the option "Enforce Content Filtering Service" for LAN zone and select the custom policy.
  7.Access the website from PC, like www.amazon.com, and check the log.
51.title: Security services for VLAN (CFS)
51.result: step 7: it will pop up alert message "this site has been blocked by the network administrator" and give the block reason "Forbidden category "shopping"". A log "web site access denied" is generated in the Log->Log Monitor page.
